about.title: About
about.description1: Contextor is a Seoul-based studio specializing in software development and technical consulting. We design, build, and ship products across platforms — from mobile apps to enterprise systems.
about.description2: Our small, focused team moves fast without compromising quality. We leverage modern tools and automation to deliver results that traditionally require much larger teams.

page.title: Services
page.intro: Contextor designs how AI fits into your work. For individuals, we build the habits and structure to use AI well. For companies, we deliver custom AI platforms and adoption strategy.

flagship.title: Personal AI Consulting
flagship.description: We go beyond learning AI — we help you wire it into your actual work and projects. After payment, a private channel opens and 1:1 sessions run on your schedule.
features: 1:1 diagnosis — review your AI subscriptions, hardware, and workflow, then design the optimal setup
Private Discord channel — text coaching plus voice and video (Google Meet) sessions
Hands-on project coaching — work automation, vibe coding, and shipping prototypes
Session reports — timestamped notes and summaries from our meeting tools

sections.title: 1. Introduction
sections.content: Contextor Co., LTD. ("Contextor," "we," "our," or "us") is committed to protecting your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and safeguard your personal information when you use our website and services.

sections.title: 2. Information We Collect
sections.content: We may collect the following types of information:
list: Personal Data: Name, email address, and other contact details you provide when contacting us.
Usage Data: Information about how you access and use our website, including IP address, browser type, pages visited, and time spent.
Device Information: Device type, operating system, and unique device identifiers.

sections.title: 3. How We Use Information
list: Provide, maintain, and improve our services
Respond to your inquiries and requests
Send relevant communications with your consent
Analyze usage patterns to enhance user experience

sections.title: 4. Third-Party Services
sections.content: We may use third-party services for hosting, analytics, and other operational purposes. These services may collect information as specified in their own privacy policies.

sections.title: 5. Data Retention
sections.content: We retain your personal information only for as long as necessary to fulfill the purposes outlined in this policy, or as required by law.

sections.title: 6. Your Rights
sections.content: Depending on your jurisdiction, you may have the right to:
list: Access the personal data we hold about you
Request deletion of your personal data
Object to or restrict processing of your data

sections.title: 7. Children's Privacy
sections.content: Our services are not directed to children under the age of 14. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children.

sections.title: 8. Changes to This Policy
sections.content: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Any changes will be posted on this page with an updated effective date.

sections.title: 9. Contact Us
sections.content: If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact us at admin@contextor.cc.
